title: finding(plugin-list): `ListView`'s columns-only filter fallback reads `options` off a list column, a key `ListColumnSchema` refuses
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a seam defect (class b): the consumer-side read of an undeclared key that AGENTS.md 0.1 forbids. It is the sibling of objectui#7531, outside that card's ruling. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#7531 (PR objectui#10544). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Site (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main` `c2c4372c2`)

`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, the `!objectDef?.fields` columns-only fallback of the filter/sort candidate builder: `options: buildOptions(fieldName, f.options)`, where `f` is a list-view COLUMN.

## Measured (the dev's probes, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

- `ListColumnSchema.safeParse` on a column carrying `options` is REFUSED `unrecognized_keys` ("Unrecognized key(s) on this list column: `options`"), with no rename hint. The declared keys are `field`, `label`, `width`, `align`, `hidden`, `sortable`, `resizable`, `wrap`, `type`, `pinned`, `summary`, `prefix`, `link` and `action`.
- An AST census of `options` over list columns found **0 list-column producers**. There are 6 hits in objectui (line-item and flow-config columns, different contracts) and 2 in objectstack (`record:line_items` columns in `examples/app-showcase` `project-detail.page.ts`).

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The same class and site as objectui#7531, whose ruling (`5809501335`, letter **remove**) covered only the three relational keys. A new branch may reuse that ruling, as the triage did for objectui#10485. ⛔ This seat does not extend the ruling itself.
- The shape of the fix, if the ruling carries over: drop the `options` read from the fallback, so select options come from the object definition once it loads.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `ListColumnSchema` near `options` ⇒ PR objectui#10544 and PR objectui#9924 (a grid pin, a different surface). `buildOptions` ⇒ 0. `columns-only fallback` ⇒ only PR objectui#10544. Must-hit control `ListColumnSchema` ⇒ 6 hits.

Dedupe words: `ListView columns-only fallback options` · `ListColumnSchema options undeclared` · `candidateFields column options`
